# Belongs to physics_5054_past_paper_questions_with_ms.pdf (4,358 pages, 80,941,691 bytes). Written 2026-11-13 08:46 UTC by tools/bank/breports.py.
# Part 1: the 2,709 records of the bank, in the order of the bank (subsection; year; May/June before October/November; variant; paper; question number).
# Part 2: the 1,654 questions of the 156 papers used that are not on a selected subsection. Part 3: the 255 questions of the 10 question papers without a mark scheme. Part 4: 2 duplicate files.
# A record is one original question printed once under one syllabus subsection. Record ID = subsection | session and year (s = May/June, w = October/November) | paper | variant | question number. A Paper 2 question that tests several selected subsections has one record in each; several tracker rows of the same question in one subsection are one record.
# Scope: the bank always shows the WHOLE question and the WHOLE official mark scheme of that question. The scope field names the parts (and marks) that put the question into the subsection.
# Source pages are page numbers of the source PDF (first page = 1). Bank pages are page numbers of the bank PDF.
# Diagram preservation: "preserved" = the question is reproduced as pictures of the full width of the source page, from the first line of the question to its last line; every picture was compared pixel by pixel with a fresh rendering of the source region (check B3b of the audit), no stroke crosses a cut line (V11) and no ink of the page is left outside the crops (V10).
# Association verification: "verified" = the scheme shown is the scheme of the question with the same number in the mark scheme of the same paper (same year, session, paper, variant). Paper 2: the crop runs from the label of the question in the scheme to the label of the next question; in the paper-by-paper verification every sub-question of the paper was matched to its scheme entry. Paper 1: the crop is the row of the published answer key with that question number; the answer recorded in the verification (worked out from the question; for a question repeated word for word in another paper, taken from that question) agrees with the key letter for all 3,120 questions of the 78 papers.
# Excluded rows: "not on a selected subsection" = no part of the question belongs to a selected subsection (the subsection field names the sections it belongs to).
# Final status: INCLUDED, or EXCLUDED with the reason.
#
# Fields (separated by TAB): record_id, bank_pages, year, session, paper, variant, question, chapter, subsection, scope, question_paper_file, question_paper_source_pages, mark_scheme_file, mark_scheme_source_pages_and_section, diagram_preservation, association_verification, final_status
